_readme: The model libraries the superbased SDK can auto-instrument, by SDK language. The website's install boxes render one chip per row (the @@sdk.<id>.libs@@ token of website/docs-tools/pagegen). target is the name passed to instrument([...]). Python rows name the pip extra of sdk/python/pyproject.toml ([project.optional-dependencies], without all and the test sets); TypeScript rows name the optional peer dependency of sdk/typescript/package.json. A pagegen test pins both lists to those two files, so a new instrumentor is added here in the same change. Go and Java have no instrumentors and no rows. note is a short condition shown as the chip's tooltip.
